<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include">
    <sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <access>package_private</access>
        <active>true</active>
        <api_name>sn_invst_pln.FinancialsCoreBudgetGridAPI</api_name>
        <caller_access/>
        <client_callable>false</client_callable>
        <description/>
        <mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable>
        <name>FinancialsCoreBudgetGridAPI</name>
        <sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable>
        <script><![CDATA[var FinancialsCoreBudgetGridAPI = Class.create();
FinancialsCoreBudgetGridAPI.prototype = Object.extendsObject(CostPlanBreakdownDataApi, {

    costPlanCurrencyList: [],
    deleteCostPlanContextMenu: [],

    getCostPlanBreakdownBudgetData: function(investmentId, entitySysId, timeScale, timeScope, entityStartDate, entityEndDate, table, currencySymbol) {
        try {
        this.entityStartDate = entityStartDate;
        this.entityEndDate = entityEndDate;
        this.budgetAllocationAttribute = this.getBudgetAllocationAttribute();
        this.budgetAllocationAttributeData = this.getBudgetAllocationAttributeData();

        this.costPlanBreakdownAggreationApi = new CostPlanBreakdownAggregationApi(entitySysId, timeScale, this.entityStartDate, this.entityEndDate, this);
        this.fiscalPeriodHierarchy = this.costPlanBreakdownAggreationApi.getColumnMetadataField('hierarchy', timeScope, table);

        const response = {};
        response.columns = this.getColumnConfig(entitySysId, timeScale, timeScope, table, true);
        response.costData = this.getCostPlanData(investmentId, entitySysId, timeScale, timeScope, table);
        response.budgetData = this.getBudgetData(investmentId, timeScale);
        response.budgetAllocationAttributeData = this.budgetAllocationAttributeData;
        response.budgetAllocationAttribute = this.budgetAllocationAttribute;
        response.fiscalPeriodHierarchy = this.fiscalPeriodHierarchy;
        response.costPlanCurrencyList = this.getCostPlanCurrencyList();
        response.deleteCostPlanContextMenu = this.deleteCostPlanContextMenuItem();

        return response;
        } catch(e) {
        gs.error("FinancialsCoreBudgetGridAPI: error occured during budget grid data fetch: "+JSON.stringify(e.stack));
        }
    },

    getBudgetAndCostData: function(budgetData, costData, timeScale) {
        const groupedCostData = this.getParentCostData(costData, timeScale);
        const groupedBudgetData = this.getParentBudgetRecords(budgetData, timeScale);
        return groupedCostData.map((costPlanRow) => {
            var budgetRow = groupedBudgetData.find(i => i.id === costPlanRow.id);
            return {...costPlanRow, ...budgetRow};
        });
    },

    getBudgetAllocationAttribute: function() {
        var budgetAttribute = gs.getProperty('sn_invst_pln.budget_allocation_attribute');
        if (budgetAttribute === 'cost_type') return 'resource_type';
        return budgetAttribute;
    },

    getCostPlanData: function(investmentId, entitySysId, timeScale, timeScope, table) {
        return this.getCostPlanBreakdownGridData(investmentId, entitySysId, timeScale, timeScope, table);
    },

    getParentCostData: function(costPlanData) {
        var groupedCostPlanRecords = this.getGroupedCostPlanRecords(costPlanData);
        return this.groupData(groupedCostPlanRecords);
    },

    getGroupedCostPlanRecords: function(costData) {
        var groupedCPs = costData.reduce((acc, row) => {
            const breakdownDataRow = row.breakdownData;
            const costPlanDataRow = row.costPlanData;
            const attribute = costPlanDataRow[`${this.budgetAllocationAttribute}`].value;
            Object.keys(breakdownDataRow).forEach(fiscalPeriod => {
                if (this.fiscalPeriodHierarchy[fiscalPeriod]) {
                    if (acc[attribute]) {
                        acc[attribute][fiscalPeriod] = {
                            value: (acc[attribute][fiscalPeriod] && parseFloat(acc[attribute][fiscalPeriod].value)) ? parseFloat(acc[attribute][fiscalPeriod].value) + parseFloat(breakdownDataRow[fiscalPeriod].value) : parseFloat(breakdownDataRow[fiscalPeriod].value),
                            displayValue: (acc[attribute][fiscalPeriod] && parseFloat(acc[attribute][fiscalPeriod].value)) ? this.getFormatedCurrencyValue(parseFloat(acc[attribute][fiscalPeriod].value) + parseFloat(breakdownDataRow[fiscalPeriod].value)) : this.getFormatedCurrencyValue(parseFloat(breakdownDataRow[fiscalPeriod].value)),
                        };
                    } else {
                        acc[attribute] = {};
                        acc[attribute][fiscalPeriod] = breakdownDataRow[fiscalPeriod];
                    }
                }
            });
            acc[attribute] = {...acc[attribute], ...costPlanDataRow};
            return acc;
        }, {});
        return groupedCPs;
    },

    modifyLeftHeaderColumns: function(columns) {
        var leftColumns = columns.filter(field => field.section === 'left');
        leftColumns = this.swapAttributes(leftColumns);
        var otherColumns = columns.filter(field => !field.section || field.section !== 'left');
        return leftColumns.concat(otherColumns);
    },

    _getBudgetCriteria: function() {
        let criteria = 'parentIN';
        this.budgetAllocationAttributeData.forEach(field => {
            criteria += `${field.id},`;
        });
        return criteria.substring(0, criteria.length - 1);
    },

    _getCostPlanCriteria: function() {
        var criteria = '';
        this.budgetAllocationAttributeData.forEach(field => {
            criteria += `parent!=${field.id}^`;
        });
        return criteria.substring(0, criteria.length - 1);
    },

    _modifyBreakdownHeaderColumns: function(breakdownHeaderColumns) {
        breakdownHeaderColumns = [...breakdownHeaderColumns.reduce((columns, field) => {
            if (field.name.indexOf("EAC") === -1) {
                var fiscalPeriodEndDate = field.fiscal_end_date_time;
                const budgetLabel = gs.getMessage('Budget');
                const costLabel = (fiscalPeriodEndDate && this.isPastFiscalPeriod(new GlideDateTime(), fiscalPeriodEndDate)) ? gs.getMessage('Actuals') : ((this.hasActualsAndPlanned(field, new GlideDateTime(new GlideDateTime()))) ? FinancialsConstants.VARIANCE_EAC : gs.getMessage('Planned'));

                let additionalDetails = [];
                if (costLabel === FinancialsConstants.VARIANCE_EAC) {
                    additionalDetails = [{
                        type: "paragraph",
                        props: FinancialsConstants.EAC_MSG
                    }];
                }
                const otherConfig = {
                    budgetConfig: {
                        editable: new FinancialsCoreUIUtil().hasWriteAccesOnTable('sn_invst_pln_invst_budget') ? true : false,
                        enableSmartCellBackground: true,
                        criteria: this._getBudgetCriteria(),
                        enableIndicator: true,
                        indicatorPosition: 'CELL_START'
                    },
                    costPlanConfig: {
                        ...field,
                        backgroundColour: FinancialsConstants.budgetHeaderColors.secondary,
                        criteria: this._getCostPlanCriteria(),
                        label: costLabel,
                        additionalDetails: additionalDetails
                    },
                    varianceConfig: {
                        editable: false
                    }
                };

                return [...columns, {
                    ...this._getSubColumns(field.name, field.label, budgetLabel, costLabel, field.type, field.width, field.additionalDetails, otherConfig)
                }];
            } else {
                return [...columns, {
                    ...field
                }];
            }
        }, [])];
        return breakdownHeaderColumns;
    },

    addParentToCostPlan: function(costPlanBreakdownData) {
        return costPlanBreakdownData.reduce((acc, row) => {
            row.parent = row[`${this.budgetAllocationAttribute}`].value;
            delete row[`${this.budgetAllocationAttribute}`].displayValue;
            acc.push(row);
            return acc;
        }, []);
    },

    getLeftColumns: function(columns) {
        var leftColumns = columns.filter(field => field.section === 'left');
        leftColumns = this.swapAttributes(leftColumns);
        return leftColumns;
    },

    swapAttributes: function(columns) {
        return columns.reduce((acc, row) => {
            row.groupable = false; //update to false as column groupable option is not needed in budget screen
            if (row.name !== `${this.budgetAllocationAttribute}`) acc.push(row);
            else {
                row.type = 'text';
                acc.unshift(row);
            }
            return acc;
        }, []);
    },

    appendCalculatedFields: function(headerColumns, calculatedFields, fieldName, fieldLabel, extraColumnWidth = 0) {
        return [...headerColumns, ...calculatedFields.reduce((calculatedColumns, field) => {
            if (field.name.indexOf('EAC') > -1) {
                const label = fieldLabel ? gs.getMessage("{0}", fieldLabel) : gs.getMessage("Full scope");
                const name = fieldName ? fieldName + "_" + field.name : field.name;
                const budgetLabel = gs.getMessage("Budget");
                const costLabel = FinancialsConstants.VARIANCE_EAC;

                const otherConfig = {
                    budgetConfig: {
                        //for fullscope fieldName is undefined hence editable false
                        editable: fieldName && new FinancialsCoreUIUtil().hasWriteAccesOnTable('sn_invst_pln_invst_budget') ? true : false,
                        enableSmartCellBackground: true,
                        criteria: this._getBudgetCriteria(),
                        enableIndicator: true,
                        indicatorPosition: 'CELL_START'
                    },
                    costPlanConfig: {
                        enableSmartCellBackground: true,
                        criteria: this._getCostPlanCriteria(),
                        additionalDetails: field.additionalDetails
                    },
                    varianceConfig: {
                        editable: false
                    }
                };

                return [{
                    ...this._getSubColumns(name, label, budgetLabel, costLabel, field.type, field.width + extraColumnWidth, null, otherConfig)
                }];
            }
        }, [])];
    },

    _getSubColumns: function(columnName, columnLabel, budgetLabel, costLabel, fieldType, fieldWidth, additionalDetails, otherConfig = null) {
        const varianceLabel = gs.getMessage('Variance');
        return {
            name: columnName + "_parent",
            label: columnLabel,
            additionalDetails,
            hidePersonalization: true,
            subColumns: [{
                ...this._getSubColumnMetadata(columnName + "_budget", budgetLabel, fieldType, fieldWidth, FinancialsConstants.budgetHeaderColors.primary, otherConfig.budgetConfig)
            }, {
                ...this._getSubColumnMetadata(columnName, costLabel, fieldType, fieldWidth, FinancialsConstants.budgetHeaderColors.secondary, otherConfig.costPlanConfig)
            }, {
                ...this._getSubColumnMetadata(columnName + "_variance", varianceLabel, fieldType, fieldWidth, '', otherConfig.varianceConfig)
            }]
        };
    },

    _getSubColumnMetadata: function(name, label, type, width, backgroundColour, config) {
        const extendedHeaderContextMenu = [];
        const columnMetadata = {
            name,
            label,
            type,
            width,
            backgroundColour,
            extendedHeaderContextMenu,
            hidePersonalization: true,
            enableIndicator: false,
            indicatorPosition: 'CELL_START',
            cellContextMenu: false,
            aggregation: {
                aggregateType: "SUM"
            },
            hideCurrencySymbol: true,
            ...config
        };
        if (name.indexOf('_variance') > -1) {
            columnMetadata['coloredFields'] = [{
                    criteria: name + '.value<0',
                    colorCode: '--now-color_surface--divider-1',
                    color: '--now-color_alert--critical-2'
                },
                {
                    criteria: name + '.value>=0',
                    colorCode: '--now-color_surface--divider-1',
                    color: '--now-color_text--primary'
                },
                {
                    criteria: name + '.valueISEMPTY',
                    colorCode: '--now-color_surface--divider-1',
                    color: '--now-color_text--primary'
                }
            ];
        }
        if (name.indexOf("_budget") > -1) {
            //skipping copy paste option for full scope
            if (config && config.editable) {
                extendedHeaderContextMenu.push({
                    id: 'copy_paste',
                    label: gs.getMessage('Copy cost as budget')
                });

                columnMetadata['enableIndicator'] = true;
                columnMetadata['indicatorPosition'] = "CELL_START";
            }
        }
        return columnMetadata;
    },

    getLeafFiscalPeriods() {
        var leafFiscalPeriods = [];
        var uniqueFiscalTypes = FiscalCalendarAPI.getUniqueFiscalTypes();
        var leafFiscalType = uniqueFiscalTypes[uniqueFiscalTypes.length - 1].id;
        for (const fiscalPeriod in this.fiscalPeriodHierarchy) {
            if (this.fiscalPeriodHierarchy[fiscalPeriod].type === leafFiscalType) leafFiscalPeriods.push(fiscalPeriod);
        }
        return leafFiscalPeriods;
    },

    getBudgetData: function(investmentId, timeScale) {
        const leafFiscalPeriods = this.getLeafFiscalPeriods();
        return this.getBudgetRecords(investmentId, leafFiscalPeriods);
    },

    getParentBudgetRecords: function(budgetRecords, timeScale) {
        var groupedBudgetRecords = this.getGroupedBudgetRecords(budgetRecords, timeScale);
        return this.groupData(groupedBudgetRecords);
    },

    groupData: function(records) {
        return this.budgetAllocationAttributeData.reduce((acc, row) => {
            var aggregatedFinancialData = records[row.id];
            acc.push({
                ...aggregatedFinancialData,
                ...row
            });
            return acc;
        }, []);
    },

    getGroupedBudgetRecords: function(budgetRecords, timeScale) {
        return budgetRecords.reduce((acc, row) => {

            var currentPeriod = row.fiscal_period;
            var budgetAttributeKey = (this.budgetAllocationAttribute === 'resource_type') ? row.cost_type : row.expense_type;

            while (currentPeriod) {
                if (this.fiscalPeriodHierarchy[currentPeriod] && (timeScale.indexOf(this.fiscalPeriodHierarchy[currentPeriod].type) > -1)) {

                    var fiscalPeriodKey = `${currentPeriod}_budget`;
                    var isOnGoingFiscalPeriod = this.fiscalPeriodHierarchy[currentPeriod].isOngoingFiscal;
                    if (isOnGoingFiscalPeriod && !this.fiscalPeriodHierarchy[currentPeriod].parent) {
                        fiscalPeriodKey = `${currentPeriod}_EAC_budget`;
                    }

                    if (acc[budgetAttributeKey]) {
                        acc[budgetAttributeKey][fiscalPeriodKey] = {
                            value: (acc[budgetAttributeKey][fiscalPeriodKey] && parseFloat(acc[budgetAttributeKey][fiscalPeriodKey].value)) ? parseFloat(acc[budgetAttributeKey][fiscalPeriodKey].value) + parseFloat(row.amount) : parseFloat(row.amount),
                            displayValue: (acc[budgetAttributeKey][fiscalPeriodKey] && parseFloat(acc[budgetAttributeKey][fiscalPeriodKey].value)) ? this.getFormatedCurrencyValue(parseFloat(acc[budgetAttributeKey][fiscalPeriodKey].value) + parseFloat(row.amount)) : this.getFormatedCurrencyValue(parseFloat(row.amount))
                        };
                    } else {
                        acc[budgetAttributeKey] = {};
                        acc[budgetAttributeKey][fiscalPeriodKey] = {
                            value: parseFloat(row.amount),
                            displayValue: this.getFormatedCurrencyValue(parseFloat(row.amount))
                        };
                    }

                }
                if (this.fiscalPeriodHierarchy[currentPeriod]) {
                    currentPeriod = this.fiscalPeriodHierarchy[currentPeriod].parent;
                }
            }
            return acc;
        }, {});
    },

    getFullScopeBudget: function(arr, record, budgetAttributeKey) {
        var recordAmount = parseFloat(record.amount);
        if (arr[budgetAttributeKey] && arr[budgetAttributeKey]['EAC_budget']) {
            var budgetValue = parseFloat(arr[budgetAttributeKey]['EAC_budget'].value);
            arr[budgetAttributeKey]['EAC_budget'] = {
                value: (arr[budgetAttributeKey]['EAC_budget'] && budgetValue !== null && budgetValue !== undefined) ? parseFloat((budgetValue + recordAmount).toFixed(2)) : 0,
                displayValue: (arr[budgetAttributeKey]['EAC_budget'] && budgetValue !== null && budgetValue !== undefined) ? this.getFormatedCurrencyValue(parseFloat((budgetValue + recordAmount).toFixed(2))) : 0
            };
        } else {
            arr[budgetAttributeKey] = arr[budgetAttributeKey] ? arr[budgetAttributeKey] : {};
            arr[budgetAttributeKey]['EAC_budget'] = {
                value: parseFloat(recordAmount.toFixed(2)),
                displayValue: this.getFormatedCurrencyValue(parseFloat(recordAmount.toFixed(2)))
            };
        }
        return arr;
    },

    getBudgetAllocationAttributeData: function(budgetAllocationAttribute = null) {
	if (budgetAllocationAttribute) {
		this.budgetAllocationAttribute = budgetAllocationAttribute
	}
        this.expenseTypes = this.getExpenseTypes();
        return (this.budgetAllocationAttribute === 'resource_type') ? this.getCostTypes(this.expenseTypes) : this.expenseTypes;
    },

    getCostTypes: function(expenseTypes) {
        var costTypes = [];
        var gr = new GlideRecord('resource_type_definition');
        gr.orderByDesc('name');
        gr.query();
        while (gr.next()) {
            var obj = {};
            obj.parent = null;
            obj.id = gr.getValue('sys_id');
            obj.resource_type = {
                value: gr.getValue('sys_id'),
                displayValue: gr.getValue('name')
            };
            obj.expense_type = expenseTypes.filter(row => row.id == gr.getValue('expense_type'))[0].expense_type;
            costTypes.push(obj);
        }
        return costTypes;
    },

    getExpenseTypes: function() {
        var expenseTypes = [];
        var currentUser = gs.getUser();
        var lang = currentUser.getPreference('user.language') || gs.getProperty('glide.sys.language') || 'en';
        var gr = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        gr.addQuery('name', 'resource_type_definition');
        gr.addQuery('element', 'expense_type');
        gr.addQuery('language', lang);
        gr.query();
        while (gr.next()) {
            var expenseType = {};
            expenseType.parent = null;
            expenseType.id = gr.getValue('value'),
                expenseType.expense_type = {
                    value: gr.getValue('value'),
                    displayValue: gr.getValue('label')
                };
            expenseTypes.push(expenseType);
        }
        return expenseTypes;
    },

    getBudgetRecords: function(investmentId, fiscalPeriods) {
        var budgetData = [];
        var budgetGr = new GlideRecord('sn_invst_pln_invst_budget');
        budgetGr.addQuery('investment', investmentId);
        budgetGr.addQuery('fiscal_period', 'IN', fiscalPeriods);
        budgetGr.query();
        while (budgetGr.next()) {
            const budget = {
                fiscal_period: budgetGr.getValue('fiscal_period'),
                investment: budgetGr.getValue('investment'),
                expense_type: budgetGr.getValue('expense_type'),
                cost_type: budgetGr.getValue('resource_type'),
                amount: budgetGr.amount.amount ? budgetGr.amount.amount.toString(): 0
            };
            budgetData.push(budget);
        }
        return budgetData;
    },

    getBudgetFiscalPeriodForInvestment: function(investment, orderByDesc = null) {
        var fiscalPeriod = {};
        var orderByClause = 'fiscal_period.fiscal_start_date_time';
        var budgetGr = new GlideRecord('sn_invst_pln_invst_budget');
        budgetGr.addQuery('investment', investment);
        orderByDesc ? budgetGr.orderByDesc(orderByClause) : budgetGr.orderBy(orderByClause);
        budgetGr.setLimit(1);
        budgetGr.query();
        if (budgetGr.next()) {
            fiscalPeriod = {
                name: budgetGr.getDisplayValue('fiscal_period'),
                id: budgetGr.getValue('fiscal_period'),
                fiscalStartDateTime: budgetGr.fiscal_period.fiscal_start_date_time,
                fiscalEndDateTime: budgetGr.fiscal_period.fiscal_end_date_time
            };
        }
        return fiscalPeriod;
    },

    type: 'FinancialsCoreBudgetGridAPI'
});]]></script>
